description: Testing whether reported ARHGAP21/ARHGAP23 partners carrying a PDZ-binding motif are enriched for class I Ser/Thr at P-2 relative to the human proteome
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import Counter
from scipy import stats

# ---- human reviewed proteome ----
txt=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream",
    params={"query":"(organism_id:9606) AND (reviewed:true)","format":"tsv",
            "fields":"accession,gene_primary,sequence"},timeout=600).text
prot=pd.read_csv(pd.io.common.StringIO(txt),sep="\t").dropna(subset=["Sequence"])
prot.columns=["acc","gene","seq"]
prot["P0"]=prot.seq.str[-1]; prot["Pm2"]=prot.seq.str[-3]
G2A={str(g).upper():a for g,a in zip(prot.gene,prot.acc) if pd.notna(g)}
print("human reviewed proteome:",len(prot))

# ---- IntAct partners (gene-symbol route; inspect keys first) ----
r=requests.get("https://www.ebi.ac.uk/intact/ws/interaction/findInteractions/Q5T5U3",
               params={"page":0,"pageSize":1},timeout=120).json()
print("IntAct record fields:",sorted(r["content"][0].keys())[:30])

part=set(); nrec=0
for acc,gene in [("Q5T5U3","ARHGAP21"),("Q9P227","ARHGAP23")]:
    got=set()
    for pg in range(0,8):
        j=requests.get(f"https://www.ebi.ac.uk/intact/ws/interaction/findInteractions/{acc}",
                       params={"page":pg,"pageSize":100},timeout=120).json()
        c=j.get("content",[])
        if not c: break
        nrec+=len(c)
        for it in c:
            for k in ("moleculeA","moleculeB"):
                v=str(it.get(k) or "").upper()
                if v and v!=gene and v in G2A: got.add(G2A[v])
    print(f"  {gene}: {len(got)} human partners resolved to UniProt")
    part|=got
print(f"  union: {len(part)} partners from {nrec} interaction records")

PHI=set("VILFAMC")
bgp=prot[prot.P0.isin(PHI)]
hit=prot[prot.acc.isin(part) & prot.P0.isin(PHI)]
print(f"\npartners with a canonical PBM (P0 hydrophobic): {len(hit)}   background: {len(bgp)}")

tab=[]
for cls,aas in [("class I  (S/T at P-2)","ST"),("class II (hydrophobic at P-2)","VILFAMWY"),
                ("class III (D/E at P-2)","DE")]:
    s=set(aas); a=hit.Pm2.isin(s).sum(); n=len(hit); b=bgp.Pm2.isin(s).sum(); m=len(bgp)
    odds,p=stats.fisher_exact([[a,n-a],[b,m-b]])
    tab.append(dict(ligand_class=cls,partners=f"{a}/{n} ({100*a/n:.1f}%)",
                    proteome=f"{b}/{m} ({100*b/m:.1f}%)",odds_ratio=round(odds,2),fisher_p=f"{p:.3g}"))
T=pd.DataFrame(tab); T.to_csv("partner_Pminus2_enrichment.csv",index=False)
print("\n=== P-2 class enrichment among reported ARHGAP21/23 partners carrying a PBM ===")
print(T.to_string(index=False))

out=hit[["acc","gene","Pm2","P0"]].copy(); out["C_term_6"]=hit.seq.str[-6:]
out["predicted_class"]=np.where(out.Pm2.isin(set("ST")),"I",
                        np.where(out.Pm2.isin(set("VILFAMWY")),"II",
                        np.where(out.Pm2.isin(set("DE")),"III","atypical")))
out.sort_values(["predicted_class","gene"]).to_csv("arhgap21_23_partners_with_PBM.csv",index=False)
print("\nclass I partners:", ", ".join(sorted(out[out.predicted_class=="I"].gene.astype(str))))
print("\nclass II partners:", ", ".join(sorted(out[out.predicted_class=="II"].gene.astype(str))[:25]))

# ---- figure ----
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
E=pd.read_csv("arhgap21_2yuy_ensemble_groove.csv")
ax[0].plot(E.model,E.Tyr98OH_to_Pm2OG1,"o-",color="#C44E52",label="ARHGAP21 Tyr98 OH (2YUY, 20 NMR models)")
ax[0].axhline(3.5,ls="--",c="grey"); ax[0].text(20,3.58,"H-bond cutoff 3.5 A",ha="right",fontsize=8,color="grey")
ax[0].axhline(2.59,ls=":",c="#4C72B0"); ax[0].text(1,2.3,"PSD-95 His372 NE2, 2.59 A",fontsize=8,color="#4C72B0")
ax[0].set_xlabel("2YUY NMR model"); ax[0].set_ylabel("distance to transferred P-2 Thr OG1 (A)")
ax[0].set_xticks(range(1,21,2)); ax[0].legend(fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_title("In the experimental ARHGAP21 PDZ structure the alphaB1 Tyr\nreaches the P-2 hydroxyl in 13 of 20 models",fontsize=10)
cnt_h=Counter(hit.Pm2); cnt_b=Counter(bgp.Pm2)
aas=sorted("ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY",key=lambda a:-cnt_h.get(a,0))[:12]
x=np.arange(len(aas)); w=0.4
ax[1].bar(x-w/2,[100*cnt_h.get(a,0)/len(hit) for a in aas],w,color="#DD8452",label=f"ARHGAP21/23 partners (n={len(hit)})")
ax[1].bar(x+w/2,[100*cnt_b.get(a,0)/len(bgp) for a in aas],w,color="#8C8C8C",label=f"proteome background (n={len(bgp)})")
ax[1].set_xticks(x); ax[1].set_xticklabels(aas); ax[1].legend(fontsize=8)
ax[1].set_xlabel("residue at P-2"); ax[1].set_ylabel("% of C-termini ending in a hydrophobic residue")
ax[1].set_title("Reported partners show no excess of Ser/Thr at P-2\nover the proteome background",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
